It sounds like you’ve carved out a little ritual that really sets the tone for your day. When you finish feeling “put‑together,” you’re likely carrying that confidence into whatever comes next. But if the ritual feels good, keep it! It’s a small, intentional act that can boost your mood and confidence for the rest of the day. What’s your favorite part of the routine?
